summary: The prepared base already contained the HTTP diffusion sleep/wake implementation from upstream PR #22659. This contribution restores the missing DiffGenerator local/offline lifecycle contract by adding sleep, wake, and disk-refit methods with consistent error handling, tests the complete client request sequence, adds a real GPU offload/wake numerical regression, and documents the supported workflow and limitations.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: release_memory_occupation, resume_memory_occupation, and update_weights_from_disk were all absent from DiffGenerator. Raw output: reports/j-3675ee25c12a/raw/baseline_diffgenerator_lifecycle.txt

Six lifecycle tests passed, covering sleep/wake/refit request construction, scheduler and payload failures, empty refit paths, idempotent calls, device transitions, and post-wake numerical equivalence to an independently computed CPU linear reference. Raw output: reports/j-3675ee25c12a/raw/test_diffusion_generator_lifecycle.txt

On AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015, a 4096x4096 Linear module released 67108864 allocated GPU bytes during sleep and matched the independent CPU reference after wake with max absolute error 1.519918441772461e-06. Raw output: reports/j-3675ee25c12a/raw/gpu_numerical_roundtrip.txt

Two existing GPU regressions passed for compatibility with snapshot offload, mmap/pinned host storage reuse, and host pin leases. Raw output: reports/j-3675ee25c12a/raw/test_existing_sleep_compatibility.txt
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, syntax, and policy hooks passed for all changed source and documentation files. Raw output: reports/j-3675ee25c12a/raw/precommit.txt

remaining_limitations: No Qwen-Image, Z-Image, or other diffusion checkpoint was available locally, so model-level HTTP generation before/after wake and semantic image accuracy were not run.

The requested sleep+wake+refit versus kill-and-relaunch timing comparison requires a real diffusion checkpoint and was not measured; the new Python API makes that full sequence callable but does not supply unsupported benchmark claims.
FSDP inference is explicitly unsupported by the existing MemoryOccupationController and was not changed.
Distributed diffusion sleep/wake and layerwise-offloaded full-model execution were not exercised; only the existing focused GPU compatibility tests were run.
The implementation is coarse-grained CPU offload, not virtual-address-preserving torch_memory_saver behavior, and does not preserve CUDA graphs.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
